### Evidence recorded in the notes

| Finding | Detail |
|---|---|
| USPTO 0.20 | 35/47 wrong answers share *no* component with the target (median Jaccard 0.0) — wrong disconnection, not truncation; only 3 are dropped co-products |
| LawBench 0.31 | 18/67 wrong differ from target only by a trailing 「罪」; 18 collapse a multi-label target to one label — surface fidelity, not reasoning |
| Instruction drift | 1 sample answered with its own plan text (`"调用 retrieve_examples 获取参考案例。"`) and made zero tool calls; 18 samples skipped retrieval entirely. Skipping hurts LawBench (0.14 vs 0.33) and Symptom2Disease, but *helped* USPTO (0.30 vs 0.18, n=10) |
| Symptom2Disease 0.80 | Near ceiling because the input enumerates the closed label set; 19 isolated errors + 1 empty prediction |
| Infra failures | 1 provider `ReadTimeout` at 423 s (retryable, didn't recover on retry) + 2 non-retryable `content_filter` rejections; all counted wrong |
